eventMetadata.context_description: Official India Meteorological Department forecasts for Lucknow on June 7 point to a maximum near 40°C under mainly clear skies, with recent observed highs around 38°C on June 5 reflecting slightly cooler conditions. Pre-monsoon heat buildup, driven by strong insolation and minimal cloud cover or rainfall, supports peak readings in the upper 30s to low 40s, consistent with early-June climatology averaging 38–42°C. Model consensus and surface wind patterns favor limited moderation, though small shifts in steering or moisture could tip the daily maximum between 39°C and 40°C—the two leading market-implied outcomes. Traders weigh these variables against historical analogs and the narrow resolution thresholds, creating closely matched probabilities around those levels.
